subject: ⚖️ Compliance Notice — $notice_subject
body:
Dear $recipient_name,

This is a formal compliance notice from the University. It is not a marketing message and may carry contractual, regulatory, or statutory weight; please read it in full and keep a copy for your records.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
NOTICE DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Notice Reference:   $notice_reference
Subject:            $notice_subject
Issued On:          $issued_on
Issued By:          $issued_by
Legal Basis:        $legal_basis
Applies To:         $audience
Effective Date:     $effective_date
Response Required:  $response_required
Response Deadline:  $response_deadline

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

NOTICE CONTENT
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$notice_body
────────────────────────────────────────────────────

WHAT YOU MUST DO

$required_actions

FAILURE TO COMPLY

Non-compliance may result in: $non_compliance_consequences.

FOR QUESTIONS OR APPEALS

Contact $contact_name ($contact_email). If the notice involves personal data, the Data Protection Officer can be reached at dpo@university.edu. If you wish to challenge the notice, the appeal process is set out in $appeal_policy.

This notice is sent on behalf of the University in its capacity as a data controller / employer / education provider, as applicable.

Yours faithfully,
$issued_by
Legal & Compliance Office
